facts.fact: 他给她烧了五桶热水泡澡；柜里的浴盐（海盐、薰衣草、迷迭香）是他亡妻自己做的
晚饭时他说薰衣草的味道让他想起「另一个时代」，并说岛上没有季节，是天鹅决定天气
facts.anchor: there are no seasons on the island. It’s the tide that decides the weather.

facts.fact: 他引用父亲的话：「To travel hopefully is a better thing than to arrive.」
facts.anchor: To travel hopefully is a better thing than to arrive.

facts.fact: 他说从这座岛拿走的东西终会回来：「Anything taken from this place will always return.」
facts.anchor: Anything taken from this place will always return.

facts.fact: 他取下自己的挂坠，把链子和 Nana 给的贝壳还给她
facts.anchor: I suppose we’ve both taken something from the other

facts.fact: 门厅柜里靠墙放着一支温彻斯特步枪，他说是为防鹞和猫头鹰叼走小鸡
她给他补衬衫，用 Nana 教的针法
facts.anchor: a basic stitching pattern I learned from Nana

facts.fact: 他带她去岛另一头的蜂箱取蜜；她挥刀赶蜂时划开他的手，随后替他缝针
facts.anchor: When I swung around—moving wildly, frantically—I must have slashed the blade right through Clay’s hand

facts.fact: 两天后她哼 Adele 的歌；他送她一枚在岸边捡到、亲手钻孔的牛角贝
facts.anchor: Found it on the shore, reminded me of the one ye wear—

facts.fact: 他刮掉胡子后她发现：不是他变了，是她变了——如今他们同龄
facts.anchor: He is not different, as I had first thought.

facts.fact: 暴风夜喝的是老邻居 Neil Hagdorn 酿的威士忌；他说「Slàinte Mhath」
她说「I’ve been here over two months」；他把她比作 Highland cow（hairy coo）
facts.anchor: I’ve been here over two months

facts.fact: 她讲起一年前他曾被潮水送到瓜德罗普
醉后她拉他在客厅跳没有音乐的舞，他迟疑地把手放在她腰上
facts.anchor: Reluctantly he places his hands around my waist
